lines:
flowchart TD
A[Core Recovery requests startup storage gate] --> B[Acquire exclusive maintenance generation]
B --> C[Read schema manifest and verify filesystem and SQLite identities]
C --> D{All store formats readable?}
D -->|Newer unsupported| E[Open affected stores inspectable read-only and block continuation]
D -->|Older supported| F[Create and hash last-known-good backup]
F --> G{Backup complete and verified?}
G -->|No| E
G -->|Yes| H[Run ordered restart-idempotent migrations]
H --> I[SQLite transaction plus staged fsync and rename JSON migration preserving unknown fields]
I --> J{Post-migration integrity valid?}
D -->|Current| J
J -->|No corruption| K[Release canonical reads and rebuild disposable projections]
J -->|Corruption| L[Quarantine affected original without overwrite]
L --> M{Core selected a validated backup?}
M -->|No| E
M -->|Yes| N[Restore into staging]
N --> O{Schema hashes sequences and referenced artifacts verify?}
O -->|No| E
O -->|Yes| P[Atomically promote restore and retain quarantined evidence]
P --> K
K --> Q[Rebuild local projections from committed sequence and portable cache from verified parent-linked segments]
Q --> R[Load frozen snapshot reference and latest committed logical checkpoint]
R --> S[Fold only subsequent committed semantic events through pure reducers]
S --> T[Reconcile dedup and outbox preserving waits approvals queues attempts and uncertain outcomes]
T --> U[Issue rehydration envelope and release startup gate]
U --> V[Resume logical scheduling from committed position]
V --> W[Never replay model tool shell file MCP plugin or external-agent calls]

data.title: Startup Integrity, Migration, Backup Recovery, Rebuild and No-Effect Rehydration
